notes.title: Update Information（March 4th, 2020）
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335237/e9283d1197bd1512d90dda4be2946f6fcad54277.jpg[/img]
Thank you for purchasing "Bullet Girls Phantasia".
The following updates have been made.

・Keyboard type alteration
When starting the game, you are now able to choose the keyboard type from the following three types in the setting screen.

- QWERTY （Default）
- AZERTY （FRA）
- QWERTZ （DEU）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335237/0185b1ceaf3ea3afd4e53c7a4e8a49fbf42f9c64.jpg[/img]

*This update is for those who use keyboards specifically for French (AZERTY layout) and German (QWERTZ layout).
 If you are using a QWERTY keyboard, please note that changing the keyboard type will affect the key operation.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Information（2020/1/31）*Add English
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335237/472576f76c671663aed986e3fbb64561836ba61b.jpg[/img]

*English information was added. (2020/2/3)

Thank you for purchasing "Bullet Girls Phantasia".
The following updates have been made.

[h1]①Mouse operation improvement[/h1]
・Improved mouse control during keyboard operation.
・When operating the mouse on a screen that does not require mouse operation such as the title screen or the pause menu, the mouse cursor will now be displayed and can be operated arbitrarily.



[h1]②Support for 60 FPS
[/h1]
The game can now be played at 60 FPS. When the game starts, both "30" and "60" can be selected in the "Frame rate" of the launcher setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335237/465f6c23379bef6dba9e03318e5f68f7d2eee6c1.jpg[/img]

[b][u]＜ Precautions when using a 144hz PC monitor ＞
[/u][/b]We’ve confirmed that when the game is played at "60 FPS" and the "Window mode" is set to be "Windowed", the game can be unstable. In that case, setting the refresh rate of the monitor to "60hz" in the PC system settings may improve the situation. We are still looking into this.

[h1]③Other modifications
[/h1]
・The full screen mode of the monitor can now be selected. When the game starts, it is now possible to select the monitor which you want to use in the "Display" of the launcher setting. This is valid only when "Fullscreen" is selected.

・The following modifications have been made.
-Improved the behavior of the cursor when operating the mouse in the "Intensive Drilling Mode".

- Fixed the character dialogue when selecting "Reset Save Data" in the option setting.

- The screen is now properly displayed when using a 4K monitor.

* If only a part of the game is displayed on the monitor, this may be happening because of the "Display settings" of your PC. Try the following steps if this update is not helping.

1: Select "Display Settings" by right-clicking the mouse in the desktop screen.
2: Set the "Scale and layout" to 100%.
3: Restart the game (if it was running).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335237/95c9f215febd4a3e1917ae648630dcddd037900a.jpg[/img]


Thank you for your continued support.
